risks.risk: Brakes may not work well (worn pads, misalignment, cable issues) even if they look intact.
risks.proof: Video clip of a safe test: squeeze brake lever(s) and show the bike stopping smoothly; close-up of brake pads/lining and cable routing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used bicycle with brakes not guaranteed (worst case: needs brake service).

risks.risk: Gears may skip or not index correctly (derailleur adjustment, stretched cable, worn cassette/chain).
risks.proof: Video clip shifting through all gears while pedaling, showing clean engagement in each gear; close-up of derailleur and chain condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used bicycle with gears not guaranteed (worst case: needs gear adjustment/chain-cassette service).

risks.risk: Hidden rust/corrosion on chain, spokes, bolts, and internal frame areas.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of chain, cassette/freewheel area, spoke nipples, and any bolts/joints; wipe test showing surface rust vs clean metal.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there may be rust-related wear (worst case: needs cleaning/lubrication and possible parts replacement).

risks.risk: Parts may be mixed/non-original or replaced (brake levers, derailleur, wheels, tires).
risks.proof: Clear close-ups of drivetrain and brake components (derailleur model/markings, brake caliper/lever markings, wheel hub markings) plus tire brand/size.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used bicycle without confirmed originality.

risks.risk: Tires/wheels may be worn or have issues (flat spots, sidewall cracks, bent rim).
risks.proof: Photos of tire sidewalls and tread depth; spin test video showing no wobble; check for rim dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if tires may need replacement (worst case: budget for new tires/tubes).

Close-up photos of chain + cassette/freewheel area and derailleur.
Close-up photos of brake pads/lining and brake cable condition.
Close-up photos of wheel hubs/rims and tire tread/sidewalls.
